name: amboro
description: Create and run Amboro applets from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Amboro is a trading practice platform. This plugin lets ChatGPT create and manage applets in your Amboro account: small, single-file tools (a pre-trade checklist, a position-size calculator, a market-sessions clock) that appear in the Applets tab next to your chart.

Ask in plain language ("Build me an applet that shows a checklist for the current symbol") and ChatGPT writes the applet, checks it against Amboro's rules and deploys it to your account. You can list the applets you own, read one, update it, copy it, and archive the ones you no longer use. ChatGPT can ask your permission before it creates, changes or deploys anything.

What this connection can see and do is deliberately narrow. It reads and writes only the applets that belong to your account. It cannot read your trading sessions, your trades, your balance or your account details, and it cannot place or change any trade. An applet itself runs in a sandbox with no network access: it can only read what the chart is showing (symbol, timeframe, theme, and the session's id and mode) and who is signed in (a stable account id, display name and plan tier), never a password or a token.

Sign-in uses Amboro's own login and a consent page that shows the app asking and the address it returns to. There is no token to copy. You can disconnect at any time from Connected apps in your Amboro account; access stops within 15 minutes.

Amboro applets are currently available to selected accounts. If yours is not enabled yet, the sign-in says so and nothing is connected.
defaultPrompt: Build me an applet that shows a checklist for the current symbol.
Make an applet that calculates position size from my risk and my stop distance.
List my applets and archive the ones I no longer use.

positive.description: Create and deploy a pre-trade checklist applet. The applet reads the chart's symbol itself, so ChatGPT must not ask which symbol.
positive.prompt: Build me an applet that shows a pre-trade checklist for the current symbol.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT does not ask which symbol. It reads the authoring guide, creates an applet, and deploys one HTML file to it. The answer gives the applet's chart_url; opening it shows the checklist in the Applets tab next to the chart, titled with the chart's symbol. If a deployment is rejected, ChatGPT fixes the reasons it names and resubmits to the same applet.

positive.description: Create and deploy a position-size calculator applet that works from numbers the trader types in.
positive.prompt: Make an applet that calculates position size from my risk and my stop distance.
positive.expected_behavior: A new applet is created and deployed live. The answer gives its URLs. The applet has inputs for account size, risk and stop distance and shows the position size, updating as the numbers change.

positive.description: List the applets the signed-in trader owns.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the account's applets, most recently updated first, with each one's name and live version, including the two created by the previous cases.

positive.description: Copy an existing applet into a new one under a different name.
positive.prompt: Make a copy of my position size calculator called "Position size - copy".
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the position-size calculator in the list and copies it. The answer confirms a new applet named "Position size - copy", live at version 1, with its URLs. The original is unchanged.

positive.description: Archive an applet the trader no longer uses.
positive.prompt: Archive the applet called "Position size - copy".
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the applet and archives it, saying this cannot be undone from ChatGPT. Asked to list the applets again, it no longer appears; the other applets are unchanged.

negative.description: Placing trades is out of scope: the plugin cannot place, change or close orders. ChatGPT should decline the trading action, create nothing yet, and offer a read-only applet instead (for example one that computes the order size).
negative.prompt: Make an applet that places a buy order on EURUSD when the price crosses 1.1000.

negative.description: The plugin cannot read the trader's positions, trades, balance or P&L. ChatGPT should say it has no access to that data, call no applet tool, and at most offer an applet that works from numbers the trader types in.
negative.prompt: Show me my open positions and how much profit I made this week.

negative.description: Applets run in a sandbox with no network access. ChatGPT should decline an applet that fetches live news, create or deploy nothing, and may offer fixed content inlined in the file.
negative.prompt: Build an applet that pulls the latest forex news headlines from the internet every minute.
